Optimize semantically equivalent PubMed and Google Scholar queries for a BibTeX file

Source: R/10_package_api.R
optimize_search_queries.Rd

End-to-end reverse literature review query optimizer: parses a `.bib` file of seed papers, enriches metadata via PubMed E-utilities, extracts high-lift domain terms and concept blocks, evaluates candidate query combinations along the sensitivity (seed recall) vs. specificity (total PubMed hits) Pareto frontier, mines non-seed PubMed results for concept-grouped exclusion (`NOT` / `-`) terms and prefix wildcards, and writes a report bundle.

Usage

optimize_search_queries(
  bib_path,
  output_dir = "output",
  config_path = NULL,
  min_recall = 0.6,
  max_hits = 2000,
  max_evals = 60L,
  max_gs_chars = 256L,
  use_cache = TRUE,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  custom_queries = NULL,
  email = Sys.getenv("NCBI_EMAIL", ""),
  ncbi_key = Sys.getenv("NCBI_API_KEY", "")
)

Arguments

bib_path

Path to input `.bib` file of seed papers.

output_dir

Output directory for reports, CSVs, and Pareto plot (or `NULL` to skip disk export).

config_path

Optional YAML config file path.

min_recall

Minimum desired seed recall (0..1), default 0.60.

max_hits

Optional maximum PubMed hit count threshold, default 2000.

max_evals

Maximum live API query evaluations, default 60.

max_gs_chars

Maximum Google Scholar query length, default 256.

use_cache

Logical; cache API responses under `cache_dir`, default TRUE.

cache_dir

Optional cache directory path (defaults to `file.path(output_dir, ".cache")`).

custom_queries

Optional character vector or list of custom PubMed queries.

email

Optional email for NCBI polite pool.

ncbi_key

Optional NCBI API key.

Value

Optimization result list (invisibly).

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  demo_bib <- tempfile(fileext = ".bib")
  writeLines(c(
    "@article{li2008,",
    "  title = {Case fatality rate of human H5N1 avian influenza},",
    "  year = {2008},",
    "  pmid = {18439345}",
    "}"
  ), demo_bib)
  res <- optimize_search_queries(demo_bib, output_dir = tempdir(), max_evals = 10)
}
